key_features_and_components.name: Kinetic Hero Section
key_features_and_components.description: Hero page header with masked line-by-line reveal, smooth parallax background of a luxury bedroom atelier, floating badge with hand-engraved brass plate reference, and action trigger.

key_features_and_components.name: Editorial Ribbon Marquee
key_features_and_components.description: Ultra-slow drifting marquee displaying artisan values: 'CRINA DE CAVALO TRAPASSADA À MÃO • ALGODÃO ORGÂNICO • CACHEMIRA DAS MONTANHAS • PLACA DE LATÃO GRAVADA MOGNU'S • MADEIRA DE NOGUEIRA SELECIONADA'.

key_features_and_components.name: Interactive Product Catalogue with Real EUR Prices
key_features_and_components.description: Filterable gallery (Colchões, Conjuntos de Cama, Toppers, Travesseiros) showing exact Savoir-inspired pricing in EUR (€). Includes hover lens magnifier and full spec details.

key_features_and_components.name: Hover Magnifier Lens & Zoom Lightbox Modal
key_features_and_components.description: Magnifying lens component on mouse move over product photos allowing users to inspect micro-details of hand-tufting, organic fabrics, and the authentic engraved brass plaque 'Mognu's' on the solid walnut frame.

key_features_and_components.name: Engraved Brass Badge Component ('Placa de Latão Mognu's')
key_features_and_components.description: Realistic CSS/SVG simulated brass plate with metallic sheen, golden gradient border, simulated screws on corners, and etched text 'MOGNU'S - ATELIER DE LUXO' integrated into product images and product detail cards.

key_features_and_components.name: Craftsmanship & Heritage Section
key_features_and_components.description: Multi-column storytelling block highlighting 120+ hours of handcrafting per mattress, pocket spring anatomy, natural fibers (horsehair, cashmere, lambswool), and bespoke customisation.

key_features_and_components.name: Bespoke Consultation / Inquiry Modal & Drawer
key_features_and_components.description: Luxury custom sizing and consultation request modal with option to choose mattress dimensions (Single, Double, King, Super King, Savoy King, Emperor, Tailor-made).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React .js syntax for all files (not .tsx).
Implement Lenis smooth scroll or Framer Motion scroll container for luxury tactile scrolling.
Ensure every clickable button, filter, image, modal trigger, and link contains explicit data-testid attributes.
The header must use a glassmorphic warm background (bg-[#FAF8F5]/80 backdrop-blur-md) to ensure high visibility.
Make sure the hover magnifying lens is smooth and responsive, allowing magnification up to 2.5x over product texture and brass plate badge.
Display all prices in EUR (€) accurately matching Savoir Beds reference catalog.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always specify properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
